                                                                                               The economic feasibility of the reliquefaction unit was esti-
                                                                                           mated by the total treatment expense, which was expressed as
                                                                                           the sum of the electric cost to operate the reliquefaction unit, the
                                                                                           penalty for the emitted carbon dioxide to the atmosphere, and the
                                                                                           commercial proﬁt of the recovered BOG. Since the ﬁrst and the last
                                                                                           were governed by the crude oil price, the total treatment expense
                                                                                           was a function of the emission penalty and the crude oil price. The
                                                                                           optimum reliquefaction fraction, which minimized the total treat-
                                                                                           ment expense, was estimated from the generalized expression of
                                                                                           the total treatment expense. Even though each component cost var-
                                                                                           ied signiﬁcantly, the optimum reliquefaction fraction stayed in the
                                                                                           range of 95.7–98.2% for all the plausible scenarios of the emission
                                                                                           penalty and the crude oil price. The analysis based on 20-year life-
                                                                                           cycle cost indicated that the reliquefaction case was much more
                                                                                           advantageous over the non-reliquefaction case.
